title: BMI versus ASCAP and Levy Music
summary: Matassa's Pontchartrain was BMI while his Levy Music was ASCAP but unused; he explains ASCAP was an old writers' club hostile to upstarts and weighted payouts.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
